subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw core docs accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide, with commercial turnkey hardware references omitted or routed outside this page?
rationale: VISION.md favors setup reliability but routes optional ecosystem promotion to ClawHub, and the canonical issue explicitly asks maintainers to set the hardware-docs boundary.

options.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
options.body: Merge the guide after NVIDIA setup guidance is source-backed and commercial hardware promotion stays out of core docs.

options.title: Route Hardware Guidance Outside Core
options.body: Pause or close this PR and ask Jetson or turnkey hardware guidance to live in vendor, ecosystem, or ClawHub-adjacent docs.

options.title: Request A Narrower Core Note
options.body: Keep the issue open but replace the full guide with a shorter generic Linux/ARM hardware note owned by core docs.

recommendation.title: Accept Vendor-Neutral Guide After Repair
recommendation.body: Merge the guide after NVIDIA setup guidance is source-backed and commercial hardware promotion stays out of core docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is listed as a maintainer in CONTRIBUTING.md and recent history owns docs policy and navigation context relevant to this choice.
